summary.text: Andy Smith is a Democratic member of the Minnesota House of Representatives from District 25B, with a tenure beginning in 2023, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Andy Smith, listed by Ballotpedia as Andrew Smith, earned a B.A. in theology from Moody Bible Institute and an M.Div. in theology from Westminster Seminary California.
His career experience includes owning a business.
Smith succeeded Liz Boldon in District 25B and took office on January 3, 2023.
For 2025 and 2026 he was assigned to the Agriculture Finance and Policy (as co-vice chair), Commerce Finance and Policy, and Taxes committees.
